note: v1, written: BEHIND THE DOOR, the opener. Deep / hypnotic techno at 122 bpm in A minor (the style board's t1 row); its illusion is occlusion. The club (909 kick and hats, the sub, a deep pluck) plays through a bus whose low-pass and damp room are the wall between you and the floor. The record opens in the corridor: a juno pad (Am9, then an Fmaj7#11 colour), pink-noise air, and from bar 5 the kick as a muffled thud through the wall. Across the eight-bar door the wall opens (about 200 Hz to full range, the damp room fading) and you are on the floor. THE CELL: seven notes (A C E B D C E) through a six-hit 3+3+2 bar, turning against both the bar and its own rhythm, its filter on 7- and 5-bar LFOs, its resonance on a 3-bar one, its place on a 5-bar one. A kickless deep section, floor B with the ride, then the door shuts over eight bars and the album is back in the corridor, the thud through the wall to the end. Patient: nothing on the floor arrives before bar 21. compscore seeds 0/11/19/29: 97.421/93.715/97.419/97.420. Drafts: the door closing over 16 bars (no mirror of the corridor) 86.99; the cell on straight 8ths 92.15; a 16th swing did nothing.
next: seed 11's recurrence (75.6); the join out to t2 (flow 16); Harry's ear on the door opening.

note: v2, written: RIGHT OUTSIDE. As the door shuts over the close's first eight bars, the level now climbs 3 dB (+1 to +4) to make up what the wall takes away. The club stays as loud to the body while its top disappears: you are standing right outside, the floor pressing through the wood, rather than walking away from it. The record hands The Gallop Splits a near-full-level thud instead of a faded one (the join out: level jump 21.4 -> ~15 dB). The occlusion is the same; only the distance changed. compscore seeds 0/11/19/29: v1 97.421/93.715/97.419/97.420 -> v2 97.808/97.798/97.802/97.807 (flow 16 -> 29; seed 11's recurrence dip gone). A step to +4 at the close's first bar read the same, but jumped the still-open floor up 3 dB as the door began to close; the ramp avoids that. At +2: 97.69.
